title: Matam hai bahrobar mein bimar-e-karbala ka
body:
matam hai bahrobar mein bimar-e-karbala ka
1. chalis saal tak jo rota raha pidar ko
zehr-e-dagha diya hain uss nouhagar pisar ko
mara gaya sitam se pota woh murtaza ka
<<DIVIDER>>
2. gardan mein tauq thi aur pairo mein bediya thi
humraha karbala se be parda bibiya thi
tha har khadam pe mehshar aur zulm inteha ka
<<DIVIDER>>
3. tha karbala se koofa koofey se sham jaana
tha saath bibiyon ke zulm-o-sitam uthana
aasa na tha safar yeh islam ki baqa ka
<<DIVIDER>>
4. khaidi bana tha jismein shabbir ka gharana
mushkil tha saans lena aisa tha qaid khana
bhooley se bhi nahi tha jis mein guzar hawa ka
<<DIVIDER>>
5. rulva rahi thi sab ko abid ki bekasi bhi
rooh-e-hassan thi naala hyder bhi aur nabi bhi
tukdey jigar tha gham se jannat se fatima ka
<<DIVIDER>>
6. sajjad ka hai nouha shabbir ka hai matam
lehra raha hai khoo mein abbas ka yeh parcham
sadiq mila sahara taeed-e-sayeda ka
